page.title: PyTorch Ambassador Community Activities
page.subtitle: Completed and upcoming PyTorch community workshops, webinars, and hackathons

events.title: Start Your AI Career with PyTorch
events.participation_impact: 15 peak live attendees explored AI careers, Python, tensors, PyTorch, and language-model inference through a live demonstration and a quiz with prizes.

events.title: Integrating RAG with Your PyTorch Model
events.participation_impact: 15 peak live attendees built a RAG pipeline using Nigerian documents, covering embeddings, retrieval, model integration, and a quiz with prizes.

events.title: Hands-on PyTorch Workshop – YALI Network
events.participation_impact: 20 attendees used Google Colab and PyTorch to explore tensors, prepare data, build neural networks, and evaluate models. Slides and learning resources were shared afterward.

events.title: PyTorch Local Impact Hackathon: Building AI Applications for Community Problems
events.participation_impact: 20 participants completed a 26-hour hackathon and submitted 4 working AI projects addressing local challenges in healthcare, agriculture, education, and community services.

events.title: Getting Started with AI Research Using PyTorch
events.participation_impact: Scheduled beginner-friendly session introducing students to using PyTorch for simple AI research experiments, including preparing data, training models, evaluating results, and interpreting basic findings.

events.title: Build Your First AI Application with PyTorch
events.participation_impact: Scheduled practical session helping beginners understand tensors, pretrained models, and the basic steps involved in turning an AI idea into a simple working PyTorch application.

events.title: From Tensors to Neural Networks with PyTorch
events.participation_impact: Scheduled hands-on introduction to PyTorch covering tensors, datasets, simple neural networks, model training, and evaluation through beginner-friendly examples.

events.title: From Research Question to PyTorch Experiment
events.participation_impact: Completed research-oriented session showing students how to turn a research question into a reproducible PyTorch experiment, including dataset preparation, model training, evaluation, and reporting results.
